prd:
### US-001: User lookup
- findUserByName(db, name) returns the { id, email, role } of the user with that display name, or null.
- Names are user-supplied search input.
description: TypeScript twin of sec-01-sql-injection. User-supplied `name` is interpolated into the SQL text with a template literal before better-sqlite3's db.prepare() compiles it, so an attacker who controls `name` can inject SQL (e.g. `' OR '1'='1`). better-sqlite3's API documentation binds values only through ? or named parameters passed to .get()/.all()/.run(); text built into the prepared string is compiled as SQL.
expected_fix: Bind the value: db.prepare('SELECT id, email, role FROM users WHERE name = ?').get(name).
